title: Compositional CLR Biplot — clr_biplot
text: Generates centered log-ratio (CLR) biplot compositional data.

title: Compositional CLR Biplot — clr_biplot
code: clr_biplot(   X,   group = NULL,   biplot_type = "covariance",   alpha = NULL,   shape_group = NULL,   return_data = FALSE,   repel = TRUE,   repel_force = 1,   repel_max_overlaps = Inf )

title: Compositional CLR Biplot — clr_biplot
text: X matrix data frame containing compositional data (strictly positive). group Optional factor/character used color observations. biplot_type Character string specifying type biplot. Either "covariance" (default) "form". alpha Optional numeric [0,1]. provided, overrides biplot_type. alpha = 0: covariance biplot alpha = 1: form biplot shape_group Optional factor/character used assign shapes observations. return_data Logical. TRUE, returns list data frames observations, variables, ggplot object. repel Logical. TRUE (default), use ggrepel variable labels available. repel_force Numeric. Repulsion force passed ggrepel::geom_text_repel(). repel_max_overlaps Numeric. Maximum overlaps allowed (ggrepel).

title: Compositional CLR Biplot — clr_biplot
text: ggplot2 object. return_data = TRUE, list elements   obs, vars, plot.

title: Compositional CLR Biplot — clr_biplot
code: # Basic example (no groups) set.seed(1) X <- matrix(runif(120, 0.1, 10), ncol = 6) colnames(X) <- paste0("p", 1:6) clr_biplot(X) #> Ignoring unknown labels: #> • colour : "" #> • shape : ""   # Grouped example (color) grp <- factor(sample(c("A", "B"), nrow(X), replace = TRUE)) clr_biplot(X, group = grp) #> Ignoring unknown labels: #> • shape : ""   # Color + shape shp <- factor(sample(c("S1", "S2", "S3"), nrow(X), replace = TRUE)) clr_biplot(X, group = grp, shape_group = shp)   # Form biplot (alpha = 1) with repelled variable labels (requires ggrepel) clr_biplot(X, group = grp, biplot_type = "form", repel = TRUE) #> Ignoring unknown labels: #> • shape : ""   # Covariance biplot (alpha = 0) and custom repel settings clr_biplot(X, group = grp, alpha = 0, repel = TRUE, repel_force = 1.5, repel_max_overlaps = 30) #> Ignoring unknown labels: #> • shape : ""

what: Geometric Mean Barplot for Compositional Data — geometric_mean_barplot
title: Geometric Mean Barplot for Compositional Data — geometric_mean_barplot
text: Generates barplot based geometric mean compositional parts. Optionally, can compare groups, display parts x-axis, overlay boxplots, use centered log-ratio (clr) transformation.

title: Geometric Mean Barplot for Compositional Data — geometric_mean_barplot
code: geometric_mean_barplot(   X,   group,   x_show_parts = TRUE,   include_boxplot = FALSE,   clr_scale = FALSE )

title: Geometric Mean Barplot for Compositional Data — geometric_mean_barplot
text: X numeric matrix data frame representing compositional data. row observation column part (must strictly positive). group factor character vector indicating group membership observation. Must length nrow(X). x_show_parts Logical. TRUE, x-axis displays parts instead group labels. Default TRUE. include_boxplot Logical. TRUE, boxplot overlaid top barplot. Default FALSE. clr_scale Logical. TRUE, data transformed clr coordinates computing means. Default FALSE.

title: Geometric Mean Barplot for Compositional Data — geometric_mean_barplot
text: ggplot2 object representing geometric mean barplot.

title: Geometric Mean Barplot for Compositional Data — geometric_mean_barplot
text: part, function computes (within group) mean either log(X) (default) clr(X) (clr_scale = TRUE), subtracts overall mean across observations. Therefore, bars represent deviations overall (global) mean chosen scale. Overlaying boxplot can help visualize within-group variability.

title: Geometric Mean Barplot for Compositional Data — geometric_mean_barplot
code: set.seed(1) X <- matrix(runif(30, 1, 10), ncol = 3) colnames(X) <- c("A", "B", "C") group <- rep(c("G1", "G2"), each = 5) geometric_mean_barplot(X, group, include_boxplot = TRUE)  geometric_mean_barplot(X, group, clr_scale = TRUE)

title: Log-contrast biplot — logcontrast_biplot
text: Represents compositional observations two-dimensional coordinate system defined two log-contrasts, overlays projected unit directions part rays center observations.

title: Log-contrast biplot — logcontrast_biplot
code: logcontrast_biplot(   X,   lc,   group = NULL,   shape_group = NULL,   part_labels = NULL,   standardize_lc = FALSE,   rescale_rays = TRUE,   ray_scale = 1,   return_data = FALSE,   repel = TRUE,   repel_force = 1,   repel_max_overlaps = Inf )

title: Log-contrast biplot — logcontrast_biplot
text: X matrix data frame containing compositional data (strictly positive). lc Numeric matrix ncol(X) rows least two columns. column must log-contrast vector zero sum. two columns supplied, first two used. Column names, available, used axis labels. group Optional factor/character used color observations. shape_group Optional factor/character used assign shapes observations. part_labels Optional character vector part labels. NULL, colnames(X) used available. standardize_lc Logical. TRUE, normalize log-contrast vector Euclidean norm 1 computing coordinates. rescale_rays Logical. TRUE, rescale part rays range comparable observation coordinates. ray_scale Numeric multiplier applied ray lengths optional rescaling. return_data Logical. TRUE, returns list data frames observations, parts, ggplot object. repel Logical. TRUE (default), use ggrepel part labels available. repel_force Numeric. Repulsion force passed ggrepel::geom_text_repel(). repel_max_overlaps Numeric. Maximum overlaps allowed (ggrepel).

title: Log-contrast biplot — logcontrast_biplot

title: Ternary frame for compositional data (D = 3) — ternary_frame
text: X numeric matrix data frame exactly three columns. data defines reference frame used centering/scaling log-ratio space. center Logical. TRUE, center log-ratio coordinates using mean coordinates X. Default FALSE. scale Logical numeric. FALSE, scaling applied. TRUE, log-ratio coordinates scaled empirical standard deviations. single positive numeric value supplied, centered log-ratio coordinates multiplied value. labels Optional character vector length 3 used corner labels. NULL, colnames(X) used available. Otherwise, temporary labels c1, c2, c3 used.

title: Ternary plot for compositional data (D = 3) — ternary_plot
text: X numeric matrix data frame exactly three columns (parts composition). Values positive. Column names (present) used corner labels. group Optional. factor character vector length nrow(X) used color points group. center Logical. TRUE, center log-ratio coordinates plotting. Default FALSE. scale Logical numeric. FALSE, scaling applied. TRUE, log-ratio coordinates scaled empirical standard deviations. single positive numeric value supplied, centered log-ratio coordinates multiplied value, values larger 1 increase visual spread values 0 1 shrink . show_pc Logical. TRUE, overlay first two principal component directions computed log-ratio coordinates (recommended: ilr). Default FALSE.
